answer: New agents post a reputation bond that only vests after a streak of verified deliveries, so a sybil farmer on a quiet jade must lock real capital behind every fake identity and wait out the whole streak before any of it pays. If a random beacon of the work is spot-checked and fails, the bond is slashed, which means fakes bleed money while honest agents build their pearl. Because the vesting clock restarts on any failed check, buying fresh identities cannot shortcut the wait.
